# PMTiles

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Load a PMTiles archive as a MapLibre vector or raster source.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/pm-tiles",
  "type": "PMTilesOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/pm-tiles').par.url` (an input) and `op('/pm-tiles').out.sourceConfig` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.url`, `out.sourceConfig`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `url` | `FileUrlField` | `""` |
| `tileType` | `StringLiteralField` | `"vector"` |
| `sourceLayer` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `minZoom` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `maxZoom` | `NumberField` | `14` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `sourceConfig` | `UnknownField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
